sources.citation: Matheny, Ray T., ed. 1980. El Mirador, Petén, Guatemala: An Interim Report. Papers of the New World Archaeological Foundation, no. 45. Provo, UT: New World Archaeological Foundation, Brigham Young University.
sources.notes: Primary NWAF interim report on first field seasons at El Mirador (Middle–Late Formative). Complements later Mirador Basin publications.

sources.citation: Culbert, T. Patrick. 1993. The Ceramics of Tikal: Vessels from the Burials, Caches, and Problematical Deposits. Tikal Report 25A. University Museum Monograph 81. Philadelphia: University of Pennsylvania Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology.
sources.notes: Primary Tikal Report 25A illustrating whole vessels from special deposits (burials, caches, problematical deposits).

sources.citation: Culbert, T. Patrick, and Laura J. Kosakowsky. 2019. The Ceramic Sequence of Tikal. Tikal Report 25B. Philadelphia: University of Pennsylvania Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology. ISBN 978-1-949057-03-4.
sources.notes: Primary Tikal Report 25B ceramic sequence (Preclassic Eb–Cimi through Classic complexes). Specialist sherd-based sequence.

sources.citation: Coe, Michael D. 2012. Breaking the Maya Code. 3rd ed. London: Thames & Hudson. ISBN 978-0-500-28955-9 (first ed. 1992).
sources.notes: Secondary history of Maya script decipherment. Not an excavation report; useful for writing-system research history.

sources.citation: Martin, Simon, and Nikolai Grube. 2008. Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens. 2nd ed. London: Thames & Hudson. (1st ed. 2000).
sources.notes: Secondary dynastic synthesis based on inscriptions. Early/Preclassic political claims remain limited; Classic dynasties are the book's core — use cautiously for Preclassic.

sources.citation: Additional Carnegie Institution Uaxactun reporting beyond Ricketson/Smith volumes already registered (architectural/sequence deepeners).
sources.notes: Additional primary Carnegie Uaxactun materials. Complements existing Uaxactun sources; no invented structure numbers.

sources.citation: Hansen, Richard D. Additional Mirador Basin architectural/sequence reports beyond Hansen Nakbe 1998 / Tigre / LiDAR 2022 already registered (Danta, Tigre complexes).
sources.notes: Additional primary Mirador Basin architecture reporting. "First state" rankings stay hypothesis.

sources.citation: Estrada-Belli, Francisco. Additional Holmul/Cival region reports beyond Estrada-Belli 2006/2011 already registered (Preclassic masked façades; ritual deposits).
sources.notes: Additional primary Holmul region Preclassic reporting. Complements existing Holmul/Cival sources.

sources.citation: Saturno, William A., David Stuart, and Boris Beltrán. Additional San Bartolo mural and Preclassic writing papers beyond Saturno–Stuart–Beltrán 2006 already registered.
sources.notes: Additional peer-reviewed San Bartolo Preclassic mural/writing reporting. Decipherment readings remain specialist hypotheses where contested.

sources.citation: Inomata, Takeshi, et al. Follow-on publications to the 2020 Nature Aguada Fénix report already registered (lidar; Middle Preclassic horizontal architecture).
sources.notes: Additional peer reporting expanding Aguada Fénix Middle Preclassic platform archaeology. Complements src-maya-inomata-aguada-fenix-nature-2020.

claims.zh: Matheny（1980）NWAF 45 临时报告公布埃尔米拉多尔早期田野季结果。
claims.en: Matheny (1980) NWAF 45 interim report publishes early El Mirador field seasons.

claims.zh: Culbert TR 25A（1993）公布蒂卡尔墓葬/窖藏/问题堆积整器。
claims.en: Culbert TR 25A (1993) publishes Tikal whole vessels from burials, caches, and problematical deposits.

claims.zh: Culbert & Kosakowsky TR 25B（2019）公布蒂卡尔陶器序列（含前古典复合体）。
claims.en: Culbert & Kosakowsky TR 25B (2019) publishes the Tikal ceramic sequence (incl. Preclassic complexes).

claims.zh: Coe《破解玛雅文字》（第 3 版）综述玛雅文字破译史。
claims.en: Coe Breaking the Maya Code (3rd ed.) surveys the history of Maya script decipherment.

claims.zh: Inomata 等后续论文扩展阿瓜达菲尼克斯中前古典大型平台考古。
claims.en: Inomata et al. follow-on papers expand Aguada Fénix Middle Preclassic platform archaeology.

claims.zh: Saturno 等后续论文加深圣巴托洛前古典壁画与早期文字讨论。
claims.en: Saturno et al. follow-on papers deepen San Bartolo Preclassic mural and early-writing discussion.

claims.zh: 米拉多尔盆地为玛雅「第一个国家」——政治形态排序仍争议，不作定论。
claims.en: That the Mirador Basin was the Maya "first state" remains a contested political ranking — not a fact verdict.
claims.disclaimer: Hypothesis: first-state / kingdom rankings for Mirador remain debated.

claims.zh: 中前古典已具备完备神王制度——证据与定义仍不足以上升为定论。
claims.en: That full divine kingship was already complete in the Middle Preclassic remains definitionally and evidentially unsettled.
claims.disclaimer: Hypothesis: Preclassic divine kingship completeness is interpretive.
